tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog /utpal dkar po'i cod pan bzhugs so// na mo lo ka nā thā ya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang gi spyi bor seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bla ma dam pa rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba/ g.yas gnyis pas shel dkar gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pas padma dkar po'i yu ba nas bzung nas snying gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i mtshan pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir ri dwags kṛṣṇa sa ra'i lpags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung du bzhugs shing / dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan phreng dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ na tshod dar la bab pa'i sku can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten zhing 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang / khyad par rang la chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta.āḥhūm̐/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang /

bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs khar hrīḥyig la yi ge drug pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku gang / de las 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / rang gi spyi bo nas thim lus kyi nang gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil nas 'thon/ shul thams cad byang chub sems kyi 'od dkar pos yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs bzlas/ mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur te/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur par bsam zhing / sems gzhan du ma yengs par mnyam par gzhag slar yang rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i snying khar hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs nas yi ge drug pa ci mang 'don/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yi/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes byed shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /sogs dge rtsa bsngos nas spyod lam gyi tshe/ gzugs cir snang thugs rje chen po'i sku/ sgra ci grags yi ge drug rnam rtog thams cad thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su mos pa bya zhing dge ba la brtson par bya'o/ /'di yang lha cig sangs rgyas skyabs mas bskul nas/ dpal sa skya lo tsā bas bris pa dge'o// //e waṃ// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor utpal dkar po'i cod paṇa/
